title: Rabbi Yaakov Garosa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 1, halakhah 1, with the additional historical folio locator 6a: when Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachman went down for the intercalation, he stayed with Rabbi Yaakov Garosa. Rabbi Zeira hid among the crates to hear how Shmuel recited the Shema.

notes.text: The locator is chapter 1, halakhah 1, folio 6a, not halakhot 1–6. The Hebrew and Guggenheimer translation support the intercalation journey and identify Shmuel as the Shema reciter. The translation’s gloss “groats miller” is not adopted as a new canonical name.
